decision_source.answer: Use one larger 24 V supply for K-LIV-LOW rather than P01 plus P03; size at least 303 W under the 0.60 planning allowance, preferably a 480 W class reference.

supply_change.note: The example is not an approved or purchased SKU; real operating capacity is subject to its input, ambient, case-temperature and installation specifications. Final hatch location, supply orientation, distribution, equipment protection and branch ratings are not designed.

planning_allowance.meaning: 0.80 and 0.75 are project assumptions, not manufacturer-specific thermal or mandatory safety factors. The former 0.90 supplemental cap is another separate project allowance and is not included in this selected 0.60 sizing rule. Verify actual manufacturer input/temperature curves and losses.

master_and_inrush.integration_status: The one-supply decision is a later homeowner-directed change and is not present in the stated master hash until independently integrated and checked.

master_and_inrush.reference_inrush_conflict: HLG-480H datasheet lists maximum 2 B16 or 3 C16 units at 230 V; the previously retained Mean Well installation-table lookup has 1 B16 or 2 C16. These are inconsistent; obtain manufacturer guidance for the exact breaker, supply and mixture rather than treating either screen as an approval.
